head.h1: Private Chef & Catering in Jumeirah — Real Prices, Menus and Timings

opening_paragraph: A private chef in Jumeirah starts from AED 700 per person — myCHEF matches you with a vetted chef who plans the menu, shops, cooks in your own kitchen, serves each course and leaves the space spotless. Jumeirah is Dubai's established old-money beachside neighbourhood — low-rise villas with gardens, just off the water — and in-villa dining fits it perfectly. Tell us your date and address and we typically reply within 15 minutes during business hours, with a chef match to follow and an itemised proposal, so booking a personal chef feels like adding a wing to your evening instead of planning a project.

add_block.new_heading: What a private chef in Jumeirah includes
new_paragraphs: Everything from the first menu email to the last washed pan is handled for you. A myCHEF booking covers a consultation to shape the menu around your tastes and any dietary needs, all grocery sourcing, the chef cooking live in your kitchen, front-of-house service where you want it, and a full clean-down so your kitchen is left exactly as it was found. For larger evenings we add service staff, and for relaxed nights a single chef plates straight from the pass. Because this is private dining in Jumeirah instead of a restaurant booking, the pace, the seating and the timing are yours — dinner can run long over the garden table or move briskly before an early start. You choose the format; the chef adapts around your home, not the other way round.

new_paragraphs: Most bookings here are villa dinner parties, but the same team covers every occasion Jumeirah hosts. Corporate hosts who live in the area use in-villa chefs for board dinners and client hospitality away from a hotel ballroom. Whether it is a quiet chef for hire in Jumeirah for six or luxury private chef service for a fifty-guest celebration, the brief drives the menu, the staffing and the setup — not a fixed package you have to squeeze your evening into.

add_block.new_heading: Private chef Jumeirah menu and options
new_paragraphs: Menus are built from scratch for your table. The chef cooks bespoke menus across Arabic , Mediterranean , Italian , Indian and Pan-Asian styles, with halal , vegetarian, vegan and allergen-aware options planned in as standard instead of as an afterthought. Gluten-free, nut-conscious and other dietary menu options may be available on request, subject to confirmation by the assigned culinary partner. Partner kitchens may handle allergens, and cross-contact cannot be completely excluded unless dedicated controls have been specifically confirmed for the booking. Guests with allergies must provide full details before confirming their event. A typical dinner runs canapés, a starter, a main and dessert, but you can swap to family-style sharing platters, a grazing spread for a garden party, or a multi-course tasting for a special night. Browse sample menus for a feel of the range, then tell us your theme — a regional feast, a health-led menu, or a childhood dish done properly — and the chef will draft courses to match before anything is confirmed.

add_block.new_heading: Villa logistics and how it works locally
new_paragraphs: Jumeirah's low-rise streets make a private chef far simpler to host than tower living. There are no service-lift bookings or loading-bay windows to schedule — the chef parks nearby, carries equipment straight in, and works from your kitchen and garden. Beachside villas off Jumeirah Beach Road, the Umm Al Sheif and Al Manara villas, and homes near Mercato and La Mer all suit relaxed indoor-outdoor dining, and the gardens are ideal for outdoor stations or a barbecue in the cooler months. The chef arrives with time to set up, plates on your schedule, and clears everything afterwards, so the only thing on your list is answering the door. Confirm date, guest count and address and the rest is arranged around your home.

new_paragraphs: How much does a private chef cost in Jumeirah?
Private dining in Jumeirah starts from about AED 700–950 per person, depending on guest count, menu and service level. Larger groups come down per head; send your numbers for an exact quote.
Which parts of Jumeirah do you serve?
All of Jumeirah — beachside villas off Jumeirah Beach Road, Umm Al Sheif and Al Manara villas and the surrounding streets — plus nearby Dubai communities. Confirm your exact address when you enquire.
What's included in a private chef booking?
Everything is included: the menu design, grocery sourcing, the chef cooking on site, the service team, plating and the full cleanup afterwards. You provide the kitchen and the guests.
Can you cater a villa dinner party for a large group?
Yes. Jumeirah villa catering scales from an intimate dinner for two to celebrations of fifty or more, with extra service staff and stations added as the guest count grows.
Do you offer halal and dietary-specific menus?

Yes. Halal is standard, and vegetarian, vegan and allergen-aware menus are planned with care instead of treated as a substitution. Gluten-free options are available on request, subject to partner confirmation and an allergen review for the specific booking. Menus without intentionally added nuts may be available on request. However, partner kitchens may handle nuts and other allergens, so cross-contact cannot be excluded unless specifically confirmed.
Is there outdoor and garden dining?
Absolutely. Jumeirah's garden villas suit outdoor stations, barbecues and terrace dining in the cooler months, and the chef sets up wherever you want to host.
How do I book?
Share your date, guest count and address; we match a vetted chef and send an itemised proposal, usually within one business day.
Can I request a female private chef in Jumeirah?

Yes — a female chef can be requested for your booking. Tell us when you enquire and myCHEF matches you with a female chef from the partner network for your date, cuisine and service style. Across Jumeirah's family villas this is a regular request, whether for a women-only gathering or simply because the household prefers it. Raise it with your date rather than once the menu is signed off, because availability moves with the date, the cuisine and who in the partner network is free.
For private chef jumeirah, the chefs and partner kitchens handling your booking operate to Dubai Municipality food-safety requirements .
